author: SilverBullet4869
body:
I was banned by Fluenza on the 24/9/2015 9:29:14 AM, for ban evasion. Now my first language isn't English and I didn't know what ban evasion meant on the rules. So I ignored it I didn't know that it would backstab me. Now that I got banned and I understood that, I am very sorry for doing it. Please can you unban me? Like a lot of players have been banned and unbanned so can you do that to me? If you can't then that is your choice and you have the freedom, I would love that you would unban me. And I promise I would do it again.

Regards,

ManCityForever
